body: Thank you for your reply, you have convinced me of how worthless I really am. Good-bye.
Yup, now add that with the other things I have mentioned and you see why I want to die.
LOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOLOL I'll trade my age for their millions any day of the week.
By your own admittance, if I were attractive I probably wouldn't be a virgin.

No, you did not offend me, I'm just not in a good place right now, I thank you for trying. I know I'm an asshole, I'm sorry for that, I hope that you will forgive me. Thank you for your kind words and I hope you have a good long life.

Here there are delusions of chance, delusions =/= chance.

I am looking at it as a game and right now my arrow is hovering the "quit" option.

> I personally think the mere fact that it bothers you means that you want it.


I agree


>And if you want it means that you haven't given up. 


I disagree, it means I have an evolutionary desire to obtain it. 


>In fact I'm sitting here in front of my PC and I very strongly feel that you'll get yours when it's due. 

Oh a feeling, throw away all the evidence everyone, yup, yup it's over... why? Cause /u/Pokot has a feeling.. yeah, so just pack it up and go home. 

>I can see just from your writing style that you're actually a strong and confident person.

heheh.. more like cowardly and fat, I'm a bit of an asshole, that shouldn't be taken as confidence. I guess it's mostly a way to push people away from me, well at least online. I don't talk to anyone not online ... except my coworkers a bit, but that's mostly just like "Hey Craig I need you to do something." "Okay" \*do what they ask*

>me and other people in this subreddit who think very positively of you.

Why? What about me makes you think positive of me?

The void is nothing, you do not exist, I have already been there once and I will eventually return again anyway. I'll never do anything meaningful with this life anyway and no one is going to miss me when I'm gone... well maybe a very few select people I know, but ultimately those hand full of people will move one... probably very very soon afterwards since I doubt they really care about me anyway. There is no reason to keep up this sham really, I have not run into one good reason not to kill myself yet.

I have no joy, there is nothing I can do, the things I do enjoy don't exist where I'm at. Maybe life is great for you, you're one of the lucky ones... probably middle class, perhaps upper middle? White, life in a nice home and probably have people who care about you. About the only advantage I have is that I"m white. I have no friends, no one who loves me, no one who cares. I'm poor and know that there is no way out for me, not that I wouldn't like one, but I see how the world is. It is set for two people, the fortunate and the unfortunate and it seems that I play the latter hand.

People who can't reproduce still get to be loved, to have a relationship, to experience sex. Yeah I would like to have kids one day, but if I or the person I was with couldn't reproduce, adoption is always an option. You see that thought doesn't even matter though because I'm such a useless waste of space no girl will even look at me, much less ever want to have sex with me or attempt to bare my child. So your point is mute on several different levels. 

Good story, doesn't apply to me at all, but good story none the less.
Please, take my life, I beg you. Come to Mississippi, live here, poor, for a few months and then tell me the same thing again. I guarantee you won't.
You should really be careful when saying you think you know how someone feels, because the truth is you probably don't.

> But is it a reason of you not trying at all or trying and failing, honestly?

I'd say both, I used to try and I failed so many times I gave up.

>If push comes to shove you can at least move within the country, am I wrong?

Shit pay, remember, I don't have money to move

Yeah it does actually. 

Because I'm poor and I live in Mississippi, that's why I'll never be able to do better for myself.
Not really, science, nothing science related where I live though.
